seo.title: Services
seo.description: Design, development, mobile, AI, cloud and cybersecurity from one team at Spark Systems, from the first workshop to long after launch.

approach.title: From brief to running system.
approach.lead: One team carries the project from the first workshop to long after launch.

steps.title: Discover
steps.body: We study the brief, the users and the systems already in place, then agree scope and timeline.

steps.title: Design
steps.body: Interfaces and architecture are designed together, so what looks right also scales.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: Agile sprints with regular demos. You see working software early and often.

steps.title: Launch & support
steps.body: We deploy on AWS or Azure and stay on to monitor, maintain and improve.
